explanations: In FleetDashboard.tiles, siteCache is read but never written: after `site = await this.repo.siteById(device.siteId)` nothing calls siteCache.set. Every device misses the cache, so an account with 8,000 devices across 12 sites runs 8,000 sequential site queries instead of 12 (N+1). Even with the set added, a single `id = ANY($1)` query over the distinct siteIds would be better.

latestReadings looks back 24 hours, so the 3-hour-old reading is returned. It is older than OFFLINE_AFTER_MS (15 minutes), so online is false, but temperatureC still comes from that reading. Devices are never omitted for being offline.

latestReadings only returns rows with `recorded_at > now() - interval '24 hours'`, so there is no reading for this device and `reading !== undefined && ...` is false. Offline status does not set lowBattery, and the undefined check prevents a throw.
The sort uses `Number(a.online) - Number(b.online)`; false is 0 and true is 1, so offline tiles come first. There is no sort by site, and the result is re-sorted rather than left in database order.
